gaps.lead: It took the artist three weeks to paint the mural.
gaps.explanation: it took X time to do = X spent time doing: spent over three weeks on.

gaps.lead: The instructions only made sense after she had read them twice.
gaps.sentence: The instructions ___ sense until she had read them twice.
gaps.explanation: made sense only after = didn't make sense until.

gaps.lead: I only found out the truth because I asked.
gaps.sentence: I wouldn't have found out the truth ___ asked.
gaps.explanation: 'Because I asked' → 'if I hadn't asked' — a third conditional.

gaps.lead: The garage is servicing my car tomorrow morning.
gaps.explanation: Arranged service: have/get something done — having my car serviced.

gaps.lead: The Minister sat down, and immediately the journalists began shouting.
gaps.sentence: ___ sat down than the journalists began shouting.
gaps.explanation: 'No sooner had + subject + participle … than' with inversion replaces 'and immediately'.

gaps.lead: He jogged every morning when he was younger.
gaps.sentence: He ___ every morning when he was younger.
gaps.explanation: 'Used to + infinitive' describes a past habit.
